propositions: rebar search currently returns full ticket bodies (descriptions and comments) for all matches, consuming excessive context; it should return bounded discovery summaries and snippets by default.
Search summary must be derived from stored summary if present, otherwise from normalized and truncated description (max 240 chars), or null if both are absent/empty.

Search snippet extraction requires matching the first occurrence of the first positive free-text term case-insensitively across a parallel case-preserving searchable string, returning a bounded 240-char context window centered on the match or null for predicate-only/negation-only queries.

The --output flag is currently unrecognized and rejected; it must support json (default) and llm output formats with distinct schema contracts (SEARCH_RESULT and SEARCH_RESULT_LLM), and --full --output llm must exit 2.
MCP search must advertise and return search_result.schema.json with bounded discovery fields, while MCP show continues to return full ticket bodies.
Default search output must reduce the configured-store baseline for SupportsIncremental from ~203 KB to <25 KB without changing query predicates, filters, sort behavior, or archived-ticket handling.
